category_title: Students navigating personal family loss through environmental symbols
scenario_title: Navigating personal family loss during a video narration project
minimal_context: The student is narrating a video of his life outside of school, showing his front yard and personal items to the tutor.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's watch the video you recorded on the iPod of your life outside of school. Please narrate what we are seeing.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is my grandfather’s boat. Symbolizes him because when we go up, we race down stuff with it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay. What else did you record?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Here is my cat, named Rip. I love my mom and my sister. They’re awesome.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright. What are we looking at now in the front yard?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: And that’s a tree my dad planted. Yeah. Dad’s actually deceased, so that’s not the best topic to talk about.
